_comment: Bibliography data for report/report.md, in Word's own bibliography field names.
scripts/write_report.py loads this, registers each entry as a Word Source and
turns the [n] markers in the prose into Word CITATION fields, so the reference
list is a live Word BIBLIOGRAPHY field in IEEE style rather than typed text.
Word's IEEE renderer numbers entries by FIRST APPEARANCE in the document, so the
printed numbers need not match the src<n> tags below. The tags exist only to link
a [n] marker in report.md to its entry here; keep them stable.
Two renderer quirks are worked around in the data rather than in code:
- Word ignores Pages for ConferenceProceedings, so page ranges are written into
- arXiv preprints use SourceType Report with the arXiv id as Publisher, which is
what produces the IEEE 'Title, arXiv:xxxx.xxxxx, year' form.
